sub_dimensions.name: Main Image

scoring_criteria.0: Blurry, background not white, or non-compliant
scoring_criteria.5: Acceptable clarity but small, off-center, or with shadows
scoring_criteria.10: White background (pure RGB 255,255,255), well-lit, and product fills ≥85% of frame

sop_checklist: Background is pure white (RGB 255,255,255), no shadows or props
Product fills at least 85% of frame
edge_cases: Deduct 2 points if product is cropped
Cap at 7 if shadows or decorative props are visible

sub_dimensions.name: Infographics

scoring_criteria.5: 1–2 images with basic text overlays or generic callouts
scoring_criteria.10: 5+ custom-branded infographics each showing a unique product benefit

sop_checklist: At least 5 infographic images with overlays (text, arrows, icons)
Each infographic explains a distinct USP or feature
3+ images follow a consistent layout with brand colors/fonts
edge_cases: If fewer than 5 infographics are present, cap score at 5
If infographics use generic templates or poor layout, cap at 6

sub_dimensions.name: Lifestyle/Use Case Images

scoring_criteria.10: 3+ real-world images with people using the product naturally

sop_checklist: At least 3 images show human models using the product in real-world contexts (home, kitchen, office, etc.)
No text, icons, or overlays present on lifestyle images
Scenes and backgrounds must look authentic (not purely studio or staged)
edge_cases: If fewer than 3 real lifestyle images are present, cap at 5
If model holds product but is not clearly using it, image does not count as lifestyle
Do not count infographic or zoomed product shots as lifestyle

sub_dimensions.name: Image Resolution

scoring_criteria.10: All images are ≥2000px and crisp when zoomed fullscreen

sop_checklist: All images are at least 1000px on the longest side
All images appear crisp and zoomable on desktop
No image is blurry or pixelated in fullscreen view
edge_cases: If only 1–2 images are ≥2000px, cap score at 7
If some images are blurry, cap score at 5

Essential Fixes: Replace main image with high-res version on pure white background (RGB 255,255,255)
Remove all non-compliant elements: text, logos, watermarks
Ensure product fills exactly 85% of frame in main image
Conversion Boosters: Add lifestyle shots showing 3+ real usage scenarios (e.g., kitchen for appliances)
Include size reference image with dimensions/scale (ruler, hand for scale)
Create 2-3 branded infographics highlighting unique features/benefits
Add product video (30-60 sec) demonstrating use and key features
Premium Upgrades: Add 'in context' comparison shots (e.g., product beside common objects)
Include detailed close-ups of materials/textures/unique features
Upgrade infographics to show competitive advantages
Add 360° spin or zoomable high-res images
Category-Specific: Apparel: Add flat lay + modeled shots showing front/back/details
Electronics: Show all ports/interfaces with clear labels
Home Goods: Include room-setting lifestyle images
Beauty: Add before/after or application sequence shots
